censor_rationale: Effective recoveries observed in V1a completed within ~75 s; ineffective actions still need time to demonstrate non-recovery. Fixed pre-run from the V1/V1a observations and not revisited after seeing results.
stability_correction: The original §12 gate required >=80% of stability incidents to complete uncensored. That conflated infrastructure health with incident recovery: half the admitted (fault, action) combinations are ineffective by construction and cannot recover. The gate now measures infrastructure reliability only; censored incidents remain in the dataset as valid observations with an explicit censored outcome.
